children: According to Sina Finance, tech billionaire Elon Musk said he did not believe former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was disloyal to the United States and was shocked by Huang's dismissal. Speaking Wednesday at The New York Times DealBook Summit, Musk compared the move to kicking Michael Jordan off a team during a winning streak and said, “That doesn’t seem like a good thing for shareholders.” He said he would hire Huang, adding, “But who wouldn’t?” Asked whether he had spoken with Donald Trump about Huang’s future, Musk dodged repeated questions about Huang and said, “We are not board members.”

title: Elon Musk: Firing Jensen Huang Is Like Benching Michael Jordan
